title: Keke masu sana'a: soso, yadudduka da ƙarewar zafi

say: Keke masu sana'a: soso, yadudduka, da ƙare waɗanda ke tsira daga zafi.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module na biyu na Baking Baking and Pastry.
Wannan tsarin yana motsa ku daga biredi na kwano ɗaya zuwa kek ɗin da aka gama, abokan ciniki suna biyan farashi mai ƙima. Na farko, hanyar creaming.

say: Soso na Victoria daidai ma'aunin kwai, man shanu, sikari da gari mai kiwo da kai. Ku auna ƙwayayen da kuke da su, kuma ku daidaita su. Misali, ƙwai 7 na Amaka nauyin gram 378, don haka ta yi amfani da gram 378 na kowanne.

say: Soso-soso-busassun suna tashi musamman akan kumfa kwai. Don jinkiri, dumama ƙwai da sukari a kan ruwan zafi zuwa kimanin digiri 40 zuwa 45, sa'an nan kuma yaɗa tsawon minti 8 zuwa 10 har sai ribbon ya riƙe a saman. Yana yanka a cikin nau'i na bakin ciki mai tsabta, an goge shi da syrup.

panel.heading: Genoise ko chiffon?
left: Dukan ƙwai sun dumama zuwa 40 zuwa 45
Yanke bakin ciki, yana buƙatar syrup
Don tari, da wuri mai tsari
right: Oil batter tare da m meringue
Tin bututun da ba a shafa ba

say: Chiffon yana ninka mai da batir gwaiduwa a cikin wani m, meringue mai sheki. A yi amfani da kwanon da ba a maikowa da kwanon da ba a shafa ba, sai a kwantar da shi a kife, ko kuma ya ragu ya nutse.
Saboda yana amfani da mai, chiffon yana zama mai laushi a cikin firiji, wanda ya dace da kullin kirim.

say: Don man shanu na Swiss meringue, zafi farar da sukari har sai sun kai digiri 71 akan ma'aunin zafi da sanyio. Wannan yana rage haɗarin ƙwayoyin cuta kamar Salmonella.

panel.heading: A kiyaye cikawa da icing lafiya

cards.d: Gasa farar fata da sukari zuwa 71 C akan ma'aunin zafi da sanyio kafin bulala. Yana rage haɗari daga ƙwayoyin cuta.
Fresh cream, custard, curd, kirim cuku da cika 'ya'yan itace suna kasancewa a cikin firiji. Gayawa abokin ciniki.
Babu abinci mai lalacewa a zafin jiki sama da awanni 2, ko awa 1 sama da kimanin 32 C.

say: Fresh cream, custads, curds, kirim cuku icing da kuma sabobin 'ya'yan itace cika suna lalacewa. Ajiye waɗancan wainar a cikin firiji, kuma ka gaya wa abokin ciniki ya kiyaye su.

say: Don tunawa. Yi amfani da ma'aunin nauyi daidai da kirim har sai kodadde. Ƙara kwai a hankali. Zaɓi genoise don tsari da chiffon don biredi masu sanyi.
Haɗa sanyi, tare da dam da rigar ɗanɗano. Kuma zaɓi gamawa don zafin wurin, ba kawai hoto ba.

items: Daidai ma'aunin nauyi, da kuma cream har kodadde
Ƙara kwai a hankali; gari yana ceton kurji

Yi sanyi, dam, tsumma gashi, sake sanyi
Ganache mai ƙarfi don wurare masu zafi

say: Yanzu a gasa soso na Victoria mai aunawa, gwada matakin ribbon da kololuwar meringue, a haɗa da crumb-coat cake ɗaya, sannan gwada zafi uku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
